name: Japanese landscape
description: Classic Japanese woodblock landscapes: a distant sacred mountain, bays, bridges, pines and tiny travellers, Prussian blue skies fading to cream.
light: flat even daylight, sky graded from deep blue at the top to pale cream
composition: wide horizontal, layered planes (foreground pine or wave, middle water, far mountain), small human figures for scale
camera_or_medium: ukiyo-e woodblock print on aged paper
texture_detail: bokashi colour gradients, crisp keyblock outlines, woodgrain and paper fibre
subjects: a snow-capped mountain over a quiet bay
pines along a beach at dawn
fishing boats under a tall wave
